source.verdict: Local-first sidecar pattern for observing agent instruction behavior, generating evidence-backed proposal artifacts, and governing any instruction patch through deterministic policy, evals, reviewer approval, rollback, and audit records.

transferableTechniques: treat AGENTS.md, RULES.md, AutoScientists runbooks, skills, eval definitions, and local.config.json as production instruction artifacts with owners, hashes, precedence, and protected sections
convert repeated PawVital ticket failures or user corrections into redacted trace bundles before proposing instruction changes
use a proposal-only audit/propose/eval loop for instruction drift, stale commands, missing handoff gates, and conflicting rules
require deterministic policy gates, held-out regression cases, reviewer approval, rollback notes, and audit-ledger entries before applying instruction patches
keep auto-apply disabled for protected headings, model/provider routing, deployment, secrets, approval policy, clinical logic, and sidecar authority
nonTransferableClaims: does not improve PawVital NIM or AI model weights
does not authorize automatic edits to AGENTS.md, RULES.md, skills, or local.config.json
does not replace AutoScientists, SIA, thermo-review, clinical review, project-manager gates, or production verification
does not justify provider-backed llmff runs, live network access, or auto-apply without explicit owner approval

adoptionPlan.action: Inventory AGENTS.md, RULES.md, AutoScientists runbooks, local.config.json, skills, eval definitions, and recurring handoff requirements.
adoptionPlan.verifier: Instruction inventory artifact records file hashes, precedence, owners, and protected sections before any proposal.

adoptionPlan.action: Convert recent PawVital ticket trajectories into redacted local trace bundles for instruction-behavior audits.
adoptionPlan.verifier: Trace bundle contains no secrets, owner PHI, provider keys, or raw production payloads.

adoptionPlan.action: Run a proposal-only audit/propose/eval loop for instruction gaps, stale commands, conflicts, and repeated handoff misses.
adoptionPlan.verifier: Each candidate patch has base hash, rationale, evidence refs, risk class, eval result, and rollback note.

adoptionPlan.action: Apply only review-approved instruction patches through VCS mechanics after deterministic policy and held-out regression checks.
adoptionPlan.verifier: No auto-apply for model routing, protected clinical instructions, deployment, secrets, approval policy, or sidecar authority.

pawvitalBoundaries: local-first artifacts only unless explicit owner approval enables provider-backed evaluation
no model-router, provider env, protected clinical file, deployment, approval-policy, or secret-handling mutation
instruction changes must be evidence-backed, scoped, reversible, and reviewed

projectManagerTicket.title: Proposal-only Tugboat governance adoption
acceptanceCriteria: proposal-only phases and no-auto-apply boundaries exist

blockedReasons: Tugboat is not installed or initialized in this repo.
No approved PawVital instruction trace bundle has been selected.
No policy file, eval suite, or reviewer approval exists for applying generated instruction patches.
